remarks: Imagine coming home to a beautifully designed Coventry Homes property with a separate entrance leading to a fully finished basement, complete with a bedroom and bathroom—perfect for guests, family, or added flexibility. The main floor is designed for connection and comfort, featuring a gorgeous kitchen with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, tile backsplash, walk-through pantry, and spacious island, flowing into the inviting living and dining areas. A convenient half bath and den complete the main level. Upstairs, the primary retreat offers a 4-piece ensuite and walk-in closet, along with two additional bedrooms, full bath, bonus room, and upstairs laundry. A double attached garage adds everyday convenience. All homes are covered by the Alberta New Home Warranty Program. *This home is currently under construction* (id:67522)
